data.description: The Standing Twister Single is a one-person waist twister. The user stands on a round orange footplate, holds the orange handle wheel and turns the hips left and right while the upper body stays still. It is a simple warm-up and mobility machine that people of almost any age can use, including older residents who want to keep the lower back supple. A single twister takes very little ground, so it is easy to add to an existing walking track or society garden. It comes in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. For the Standing Twister Single, our standard warranty of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in writing.

items.pText: The Standing Twister Single is a one-person waist twister. The user stands on a round orange footplate, holds the orange handle wheel and turns the hips left and right while the upper body stays still. It is a simple warm-up and mobility machine that people of almost any age can use, including older residents who want to keep the lower back supple. A single twister takes very little ground, so it is easy to add to an existing walking track or society garden. It comes in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. We share the exact footprint and warranty terms with every quote. For the Standing Twister Single, our standard warranty of 3 years on galvanised pipes and 1 year on bearings will be confirmed in writing.

The footplate turns on a bearing under the user's full weight, so check it for wobble and grease it regularly. This small machine is normally installed self-standing on a firm base. Keep the footplate dry and free of grit, which can make it slippery after rain.
